title: Purge audio assets from git history
description: Inventory every audio file ever committed (all extensions, all branches; known: web/public/hero/*.mp3). Run git filter-repo to remove them as though never committed; .gitignore web/public/hero and audio extensions. Do AFTER T22 (ae24ae) with a clean tree. Coordinate develop branch + worktree + other sessions (hashes change). Never force-push without explicit user go-ahead; hero MP3s were probably pushed to origin (public AnthusAI/Apricity), so GitHub caches/forks may retain them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done. Local history purged with git filter-repo (only the 4 hero MP3s, one commit f8d2357). With user approval (2026-09-24) force-pushed master, develop, main, claude/apricity-drum-sound-fonts-df8c79 and tag v0.1.0 to origin, each with --force-with-lease pinned to the expected old commit. Verified from a fresh mirror clone: 0 audio paths on all branches and the tag. REMAINING: GitHub-managed refs/pull/1/head and refs/pull/2/head still contain the old commit; they cannot be changed by push and need a GitHub Support request (cached views/forks likewise). Backup bundle of the pre-purge repo is in the session scratchpad. .gitignore now blocks audio.
